portfolio_margin_active.meaning: Portfolio Margin is activated on the Vault's L1 account

auto_borrow_occurred.meaning: adverse price movement triggered HyperLiquid PM auto-borrow on the Vault's L1 account, producing spot USDC +X and 0x811 borrow.value +X

real_surplus.meaning: real surplus of the Vault, i.e. surplus net of the invisible borrow leg

settle_accepted_unbacked_yield.meaning: settle accepted a proposedYield that exceeds real surplus, violating Σ proposedYield ≤ Σ surplus (INV-9)

assumptions: The keeper is authorized and settle is callable in the reported scenario; no unauthorized-caller condition is supported by the report.
The +X borrow amount and proposedYield magnitude are symbolic; no concrete numeric bound is given.
The auto-borrow scenario is treated as potential rather than observed.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric definition of real surplus or of the phantom surplus +X, so the amount-level comparison proposed_yield <= real_surplus cannot be numerically instantiated; only the symbolic relation is available.

limitations: Only the unbacked_yield_accepted impact is formalized; principal displacement, reported-backing overstatement, and Gate 3 cap violation are handled in separate passes.
Gate 4 annualized cap has no numeric bound and is omitted.
The relation is expressed at the amount level; no rate or per-share quantity is defined.
